texto: Build arguments with data and respond to relevant objections. **En möjlig invändning är kostnaden** means «One possible objection is the cost». Analyzes the scope and registration of the expression. Distinguish the data of the interpretation, check what evidence it holds and practice a precise paraphrase. Sequence 2 of 3: incorporates this expression and reviews the above.
